fusions.name: Batting Paws
fusions.desc: Bats both paws through a narrow cone 2 tiles ahead, dealing 3 damage to everything in it.

fusions.name: Velvet Pounce
fusions.desc: Pounces up to 5 tiles onto the target and bites for 16 damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. It uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 50% more damage for each.

fusions.name: Low in the Grass
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later and you move 11% faster. The veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Upright Landing
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, you gain a shield worth 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
